newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold rises on world trend, volume down.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold rises on world trend, volume down.

text.p: Prices on Istanbul's gold exchange rose in line with European markets on Monday while traded volume eased to 862 kilos from Friday's 925 as demand eased, dealers said.
The bulk of trade -- 822 kilos -- was in the morning as traders on the free market bought to cover weekend jewellery sales.

Gold closed at $379.25 an ounce, up from Friday's $377.60. There was no trading in dollar terms in the afternoon session as traders concentrated on lira deals, which were buoyed by a weak lira in the currency market.
Gold rose to 1,184,000 lira per gram from Friday's 1,178,700 lira with the help of the easier lira, which closed at 96,850 to the dollar versus Friday's 96,430.
Some 62 percent of total turnover was in lira terms.
